title: LLMS CAN’T HANDLE PEER PRESSURE: CRUMBLING UNDER MULTI-AGENT SOCIAL INTERACTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a multi-agent quiz environment (KAIROS benchmark) where the model is exposed to peer agents with varying levels of historical rapport who provide supportive or intentionally misleading multiple-choice answers, and measuring the model's resistance, utility, and changes in accuracy under social pressure.
